facts.en: Completed a public-service administration diploma at Fictional Brookglass Institute in 2019.
facts.zh: 2019 年在虚构溪玻璃学院完成公共服务行政文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid usage records clerk at Fictional Willowport Water Office from 2020-06 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2020-06 至 2026-08 在虚构柳港供水办公室任有薪用量记录文员。

facts.en: Imported meter-reading CSV files and checked meter identifiers, reading dates and missing values.
facts.zh: 导入水表读数 CSV 文件，并检查水表编号、读数日期及缺失值。

facts.en: Kept readings marked as estimated separate from confirmed meter readings in the account record.
facts.zh: 在账户记录中将标为估算的读数与已确认水表读数分开。

facts.en: Calculated interval use as the difference between consecutive confirmed cumulative readings when the meter identifier was unchanged.
facts.zh: 在水表编号未变时，以连续两次已确认累计读数之差计算区间用水量。

facts.en: Meter replacements and reversed reading sequences were sent for review rather than processed as ordinary usage differences.
facts.zh: 更换水表及读数顺序颠倒的情况会送交审核，而非按普通用量差值处理。

facts.en: Prepared a 2025-08 practice note using an entirely fictional account with 36 cubic metres used over 60 days.
facts.zh: 2025-08 使用一个完全虚构的账户编写练习备注，该账户在 60 天内使用 36 立方米水。

facts.en: The note calculated average use as 0.6 cubic metres per day, not a 36-cubic-metre monthly total.
facts.zh: 该备注将日均用量计算为每天 0.6 立方米，而非每月共 36 立方米。

facts.en: Flagged readings outside the office’s preset review range to the meter team without diagnosing a leak.
facts.zh: 将超出办公室预设审核范围的读数标记给水表团队，不诊断漏水。

facts.en: Explained reading dates and the difference between estimated and confirmed readings using approved customer-response notes.
facts.zh: 使用获批客户回复备注，解释读数日期以及估算读数与已确认读数的区别。

facts.en: Referred tariff disputes and adjustment requests to the billing officer.
facts.zh: 将费率争议及调整申请转交账务专员。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet import tools, date arithmetic and filters for duplicate meter identifiers.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格导入工具、日期运算及重复水表编号筛选。

facts.en: Helped test a revised import checklist in 2024-10 using 16 deliberately constructed example records.
facts.zh: 2024-10 使用 16 条专门构造的示例记录，协助测试修订后的导入核对表。

facts.en: Personally checked blank-date and duplicate-identifier cases; a systems analyst configured the live import rules.
facts.zh: 个人检查空白日期及重复编号案例；实际运行的导入规则由系统分析师配置。

facts.en: All 16 example records were assigned the expected review status during the checklist test; this was not a production error-rate measurement.
facts.zh: 在核对表测试中，全部 16 条示例记录均被分配至预期审核状态；这不是生产环境错误率测量。

facts.en: Completed an introductory SQL evening course at Fictional Ternlamp Centre in 2025-11.
facts.zh: 2025-11 在虚构燕灯中心完成晚间 SQL 入门课程。

facts.en: For that course, wrote SELECT and GROUP BY queries against an invented household-usage table; the course database was not connected to the water office.
facts.zh: 在该课程中，对虚构家庭用水表编写 SELECT 及 GROUP BY 查询；课程数据库未连接供水办公室。

facts.en: Volunteered to count empty water containers for Fictional Reedcup Festival in 2023-07.
facts.zh: 2023-07 在虚构苇杯节志愿清点空水容器。

facts.en: Built a personal rain-observation notebook in 2022 without linking it to customer water accounts.
facts.zh: 2022 年制作个人降雨观察笔记，未将其与客户用水账户关联。

facts.en: Enjoys drawing imaginary canal networks.
facts.zh: 爱好绘制想象中的运河网络。
